sloka: अनुभूतानि चेष्टानि मया वीर सुखान्यपि ।देवर्षिपितृविप्राणामनृणोऽस्मि तथात्मनः ॥२-४-१४॥
transliteration: anubhūtāni ceṣṭāni mayā vīra sukhānyapi ।devarṣipitṛviprāṇāmanṛṇo'smi tathātmanaḥ ॥2-4-14॥

translations.english: O mighty son I have experienced all the pleasures I longed for. I redeemed my debt to the gods, the sages, my ancestors, brahmins and to myself.
